fields.name: iso2
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive. Common codes: DE (Germany), FR (France), GB (United Kingdom), US (United States), ES (Spain), IT (Italy), NL (Netherlands), IN (India), BR (Brazil), JP (Japan).

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-100, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.
